name: Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art
watch: Naming-rights sale drew citizen and artist protest 2016 to 2019.
why_flagged: Naming-rights sale drew citizen and artist protest 2016 to 2019.
records_note: Kyoto City Kyocera Museum names 19 corporate supporters and the Kyocera naming-rights deal undated, but posts no annual report, accounts or board.

name: MUAC
records_note: MUAC has no records of its own; parent UNAM publishes audited 2025 accounts and lists its Junta de Gobierno; MUAC's benefactors page names donors undated.

name: Rijksmuseum
watch: Ended Saudi Aramco 2017; XR targets ING.
why_flagged: Ended Saudi Aramco 2017; XR targets ING.
records_note: It posts Dutch annual reports for 2021 to 2025 with financials, names main partners ING, KPN and Vriendenloterij, and has pages for its boards.

name: Van Gogh Museum
records_note: It posts annual reports with a financial section (2024 on its own page), lists corporate patrons by name, and names its supervisory board.

name: Groninger Museum
watch: GasTerra and Gasunie funding; Fossil Free Culture actions 2025 and 2026.
why_flagged: GasTerra and Gasunie funding; Fossil Free Culture actions 2025 and 2026.
records_note: It posts annual reports from 2005 to 2024 with a financial section, names GasTerra and Gasunie among sponsors, and names its supervisory board.

name: Mauritshuis
records_note: It posts annual reports from 2013 to 2024, with financial reports for 2016 to 2018, names partners including NN Group, and names its supervisory board.

name: Govett-Brewster / Len Lye Centre
watch: Todd Energy, an oil and gas producer, is founding partner.
why_flagged: Todd Energy, an oil and gas producer, is founding partner.
records_note: The gallery has no reports of its own; owner New Plymouth District Council posts audited annual reports for 2013 to 2025. Partners show as logos.

name: City Gallery Wellington
records_note: City Gallery has no records of its own; its operator Wellington Museums Trust posts a 2025-26 annual report and trustees page. Partners show as logos.

name: Bergen International Festival
records_note: The festival posts no annual report, but its foundation files annual accounts in Norway's register; it names its sponsors and seven board members.

name: MUNCH
records_note: The museum posts a 2024 annual report, shows seven sponsor logos with no date, and names no board; it is a unit of Oslo municipality.

name: MAAT
watch: Fundação EDP, a utility with gas generation.
why_flagged: Fundação EDP, a utility with gas generation.
records_note: MAAT has no records of its own; its operator Fundação EDP posts annual reports and audited accounts 2021 to 2025 and lists its boards.

name: Qatar Museums
watch: Labour abuses documented by HRW in 2026.
why_flagged: Qatari government entity founded in 2005 and chaired by Sheikha Al-Mayassa bint Hamad Al Thani; it oversees the state's museums and heritage sites.
records_note: Qatar Museums posts no annual report or accounts and names no sponsors, but lists its board of eight trustees by name.
other_findings: WikiLeaks, 2008-05: In a worker-rights cable, the authority's security chief says he was fired with no reason given; staff were barred from contacting Sheikha Al Mayassa without approval. 15 expatriates resigned and 8 were fired in April 2008. (Cablegate 08DOHA393)
